rulebook.title: Manufacturer / Packer / Importer Identity
rulebook.description: Every package shall bear the name and complete address of the manufacturer, or packer or importer.
rulebook.penaltySection: Section 36(1) - Up to Rs 25,000 fine for first offense

rulebook.title: Retail Sale Price (MRP) & Tax Inclusion
rulebook.description: The maximum retail price must be in Indian Rupees, accompanied by the mandatory phrase "incl. of all taxes".

rulebook.title: Minimum Font Height & Area Ratio
rulebook.ruleClause: Packaged Commodities Rules 2011, Rule 7, Table I & II
rulebook.description: Specifies the minimum height of numerals and letters depending on the total area of the Principal Display Panel (PDP).

rulebook.title: Net Quantity Statement & SI Metric Units
rulebook.ruleClause: Packaged Commodities Rules 2011, Rule 6(1)(f) & Schedule II
rulebook.description: The net quantity must be expressed in standard units of mass or measure (g, kg, ml, l, units).

rulebook.title: Date of Manufacture / Packaging / Best Before
rulebook.description: Month and Year of manufacture or pre-packing must be unambiguously declared.

rulebook.title: Consumer Care Helpline & Grievance Contact
rulebook.description: Every package shall bear the telephone number and email address for consumer complaints.

rulebook.title: FSSAI 14-Digit License & Regulatory Mark
rulebook.description: 14-digit FSSAI License Number and logo must be declared on food commodities.

rulebook.title: Ingredients Declaration (Descending Order)
rulebook.description: List of ingredients in descending order of weight or volume at the time of manufacture.

rulebook.title: Nutritional Facts & Energy Values
rulebook.description: Nutritional information per 100g or 100ml or per serve must be declared.
